subject: general
question: What is the primary function of a spark plug in an spark ignition engine?

options.text: To provide lubrication to engine parts
To ignite the compressed air-fuel mixture

solution:
The correct answer is __To ignite the compressed air-fuel mixture.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A spark plug__ is a critical component in spark ignition engines.
 
• The spark plug creates a spark to ignite the compressed air-fuel mixture in the engine’s combustion chamber.
 
• This ignition causes a controlled explosion that generates the power necessary to move the vehicle.
 
• It ensures efficient combustion and smooth engine operation.
 
• Regular maintenance of spark plugs is essential to prevent engine misfires and maintain fuel efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lubrication:**

 
 
• Lubrication is provided by engine oil, not spark plugs.
 
• It reduces friction between moving parts in the engine.
 
 
 
• **Cooling:**
 
 
• The cooling system, including coolant and radiators, helps maintain the engine’s temperature.
 
• Spark plugs do not play a role in cooling the engine.
 
 
 
• **Engine Timing:**
 
 
• Engine timing is controlled by the timing belt or chain, along with electronic systems.
 
• Spark plugs work in synchronization with the timing system but do not regulate it directly.
